verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that parts of AWS's own tooling are open source: the AWS CDK is described as an open-source framework, and AWS publishes open-source MCP servers on GitHub. Nothing in the evidence shows the core AWS cloud services' source is readable, and no specific license is named. Missing for 10: open-source availability of the core AWS platform/services, named open license terms, independent confirmation of source access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an open-source software development framework for defining cloud infrastructure in code
Open source MCP Servers for AWS
